# The people [behind the]{.accent-word} science

## Principal Investigator

::: {.pi-feature}
![Dr. Li Zhang](assets/images/team/li-zhang.jpg)

::: {.pi-bio}
### Dr. Li Zhang

[Associate Professor · Department of Poultry Science]{.person-role}

Dr. Zhang's research focuses on agricultural microbiomes, microbial genomics,
vaccine development, and food safety. His lab develops advanced molecular
diagnostic tools (LAMP, qPCR) and applies whole-genome sequencing and
bioinformatics to address critical challenges in poultry health and food safety.

**Education**
Ph.D. in Nutrition, Mississippi State University ·
Ph.D. in Agriculture Biological Environmental & Energy Engineering, Jilin University

[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=PpnVGN4AAAAJ&hl=en){.btn-ghost .btn-sm}
[ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3933-5794){.btn-ghost .btn-sm}
[MSU Profile](https://www.poultry.msstate.edu/people/lz245){.btn-ghost .btn-sm}
[Email](mailto:l.zhang@msstate.edu){.btn-ghost .btn-sm}
